product_intent: Small original Unreal game-feel calibration where player restores dying reliquaries by reading a pulse and attuning during a gold window.
player_experience: Player enters a dying fire place, learns pulse timing from the world, restores three coals, and sees the environment awaken through each success.
visual_thesis: Dead abbey-forge where ash remembers sound, and gold conducts last light.

art_direction.shape_language: suspended reliquary organs, bell cables, furnace ribs, cracked gold seams, ash-softened masonry
art_direction.lighting_philosophy: controlled darkness with motivated cold ash daylight, low forge bounce, gold timing strikes, and visible midtone form

motion_language: breathing ash pulse, cable tremor, shutter opening, contraction/lock, ignition expansion, collapse/recoil
audio_language: pulse rhythm, bell-wire resonance, one-frame safe-window hush, consonant success ignition, muted failure collapse
interaction_language: world object teaches timing; HUD mirrors but does not explain; gold window is convergence and opening, not colored text prompt
performance_target: Development Windows package remains playable with runtime content contract PASS and no critical GPU/runtime blockers; VFX density bounded by state role.
accessibility_target: Safe/hostile/success/failure readable without hue alone; audio-off and reduced-motion alternatives preserve cadence and state shape.
signature_qualities: ash as memory and failure record
bell-forge architecture maps mechanic to world
success relights physical fire channels and opens space

before_human_playtest_2: primary relic readable in grayscale thumbnail
major materials readable under intended lighting
safe and hostile states visually distinct without HUD text
no primary subject clipping in golden start/interact views
lighting has noncritical blacks only; critical path has midtones
audio/VFX/animation state evidence captured as video/audio where possible

acceptance_evidence: before_after screenshot set from equivalent camera/state positions
perceptual QA report for golden views
